facts.text: Nobu Hotel Palo Alto is in the heart of Downtown Palo Alto, in Silicon Valley.
facts.excerpt: Stay in the heart of Downtown Palo Alto, a sun-soaked Silicon Valley city that shines with rich culture, natural beauty, and creative energy.

facts.text: The hotel's interior was created by Montalba Architects.
facts.excerpt: Our interior—created by Montalba Architects—is defined by neutral hues, natural materials, and minimalist style.

facts.text: The interior is defined by neutral hues, natural materials and minimalist style.
facts.excerpt: Our interior—created by Montalba Architects—is defined by neutral hues, natural materials, and minimalist style.

facts.text: Spaces are designed to integrate indoor and outdoor areas so guests can enjoy the city's weather.
facts.excerpt: Each space is designed to seamlessly integrate indoor and outdoor areas for guests to enjoy the city

facts.text: The exterior has a wood facade inspired by Northern California, complemented by a custom mural of El Palo Alto.
facts.excerpt: The exterior’s sleek wood façade is inspired by our Northern California home, complemented by a custom mural of El Palo Alto.

facts.text: The hotel's design centerpiece is its garden, which is connected to the Nobu Palo Alto restaurant and merges craftsmanship with traditional Japanese elements.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel’s design centerpiece is our garden, a lush sanctuary connected to Nobu Palo Alto that merges curated craftsmanship with traditional Japanese elements

facts.text: Accommodations include Ryokan rooms and suites alongside guest rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: Guest Rooms, Suites & Ryokan Accommodations

facts.text: Rooms feature the signature Nobu bed.
facts.excerpt: Signature Nobu bed

facts.text: Rooms come with linen yukata.
facts.excerpt: Linen yukata

facts.text: Bathrooms are stocked with Natura Bisse bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Natura Bissé bath amenities

facts.text: Rooms include complimentary Nespresso and Ikaati tea.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Nespresso and Ikaati tea

facts.text: Room details include a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Private balcony

facts.text: The Nobu Palo Alto restaurant serves Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's signature dishes such as Black Cod Miso alongside California-inspired plates and exclusive sakes unique to Palo Alto.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy signature dishes in the dining room or at the exclusive sushi bar—including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi—alongside offerings unique to Palo Alto, including California-inspired plates and exclusive sakes.

facts.text: Weekend afternoon tea is served with Ikaati Tea in the Japanese-inspired garden.
facts.excerpt: Zen ambiance is paired with Ikaati Tea in our Japanese-inspired garden.

facts.text: The hotel embodies the Japanese philosophy of Shiawase, a celebration of happiness and well-being.
facts.excerpt: Nobu Hotel Palo Alto embodies the Japanese philosophy of Shiawase — a celebration of happiness and well-being

facts.text: A 24/7 fitness center on the second floor has Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: Discover an elevated, 24/7 workout experience in our fitness center featuring innovative Technogym equipment

facts.text: The hotel's spa partner is Watercourse Way Bath House Spa, about a five-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Watercourse Way Bath House Spa, is an award-winning wellness destination inspired by the natural hot springs of Tassajara just five-minutes walking distance from the hotel.

facts.text: Watercourse Way offers private hot tub rooms with steam or sauna facilities and massages.
facts.excerpt: Experience the serenity of one of their private hot tub rooms with steam or sauna facilities, treat yourself to a relaxing massage

facts.text: Service is infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtful, attentive service infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.

facts.text: Valet parking is offered at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Yes, we’re pleased to offer valet parking at a $55 daily rate.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Unfortunately, we do not allow pets at Nobu Hotel Palo Alto.

facts.text: Children under 12 stay free with an accompanying adult, and cribs are available on request at no additional charge.
facts.excerpt: Children under 12 years of age stay free with an accompanying adult and cribs are available upon request at no additional charge.

facts.text: The nearest airport is San Jose International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The nearest airport to Palo Alto is the San Jose International Airport, just 17 miles away.

facts.text: Stanford University's campus, Filoli Historic House and Gardens and Baylands Nature Preserve are nearby green spaces.
facts.excerpt: from the sprawling grounds of Stanford University’s prestigious campus to the stunning landscape of the Filoli Historic House & Gardens, and undisturbed natural habitats of Baylands Nature Preserve

facts.text: Downtown Palo Alto has walkable, tree-lined streets with open-air cafes, farmers' markets, theatres and bookstores.
facts.excerpt: Downtown Palo Alto embodies small-town charm with its walkable streets and tree-lined avenues, dotted with open-air cafés, farmers’ markets, theatres, bookstores, and abundant shopping and dining options.
